verdict.rationale: Supply-chain protections are a fair question for a Python package manager like uv, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents blocking build or install scripts, enforcing a minimum release age, or any other malicious-package safeguard. The lockfile and version-constraint material is adjacent and does not provide these protections.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can turn on protections against malicious packages, such as blocking lifecycle scripts or enforcing a minimum release age
